description: This Java source file defines the class IntentApiTrigger, which implements a Trigger interface to handle voice recognition initiation and result processing within an Android input method service. It manages starting voice recognition, handling recognition results, and committing recognized text to the input connection.

classes.name: IntentApiTrigger
classes.description: A class that triggers voice recognition via Android's Intent API, manages recognition results, and commits text to the input connection.

methods.name: IntentApiTrigger
methods.description: Constructor initializing the trigger with the input method service, setting up callback, handler, and uppercase characters.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognition
methods.description: Starts voice recognition for a specified language.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if voice recognition activity is installed on the device.

methods.name: postResult
methods.description: Posts the recognition result to be committed into the input connection.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Handles the event when input view starts, and schedules commit if there is a recognition result.

methods.name: scheduleCommit
methods.description: Schedules the commit of recognition result on the main thread.

methods.name: commitResult
methods.description: Commits the recognition result into the current input connection, formatting it as needed.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the recognized text by adjusting whitespace and capitalization based on surrounding text.
